page.title: Customers
page.subtitle: Your shop's customer book: rental history, debt, notes and documents — visible only to your shop.

permission.title: You don't have permission to view the customer book
permission.description: Ask the shop owner to grant you the "Customers" permission.

filters.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, phone number or email

hints.relationship: "Returning" means a customer who has completed 2 or more trips. "Archived" sits outside every other group.
hints.riskLevel: "Watchlist" only warns whoever is on duty, it blocks nothing. "Refused service" blocks NEW requests and bookings at this shop; existing bookings are untouched.
hints.notes: Notes are visible only inside your shop — the customer never sees them.
hints.documents: Files live in private storage. Every time one is opened it is written to the audit log, and it needs the file-view permission.
hints.debt: Outstanding = booking total − amount collected, ignoring cancelled bookings.

detail.blockedBannerBody: NEW requests and bookings are blocked at this shop. The customer only receives a neutral message and never learns the internal reason.

detail.watchlistBannerBody: This is only a reminder for whoever is on duty — nothing is blocked.

form.phoneHelp: This is how the system recognises a returning customer — one number means one profile within the shop.
form.duplicateHint: Two profiles are never merged automatically. Open the existing profile to update it, or check the phone number you just entered.
